name: Abhorrers
blurb: An ancient heretic order that split from the Holy Lance Church to fight necromancy by studying it. Repentant monk-knights, in theory opposed to hell yet necromancers all the same — deadly with Starmetal Sword Arts and consummate monster hunters.

specialMechanic.name: Miracle
specialMechanic.text: A unit affected by a Miracle has a 5+ effect chance to instantly return to life at 1 hp at the end of any turn it is slain, clearing all tokens.

specialTags.Stance: An ability with stance gains different effects on odd, even, or special numbered rounds.

traits.name: Holy Vessel
traits.text: Lacks Miracle, but while alive, miracle triggers for adjacent allies on a 4+, and gains 1 SOUL the first time it triggers in a round.

acts.name: Starmetal Godsword
acts.text: On hit: 1 damage. Stance (Odd): and step 2, (Even): and gain 1 vitality, (Round 5+): increase damage to 3.

souls.name: Absolution
souls.text: Turn start: self takes 1 piercing (can't slay); one ally in range gains one, (3+) two, (5+) three vitality.

souls.name: Will of God
souls.text: Turn start: self or ally may treat the current round as either 2 or 5 this turn.

traits.name: Miracle
traits.text: 5+ chance to return to life at 1 hp at the end of a turn it is slain.

traits.name: Thrall
traits.text: 2 per unit slot; may activate two at a time.

acts.name: Mea Culpa
acts.text: Splash (self): remove one negative token from allies in range and place them on this unit. Then remove one, (4+) two, or (6+) all negative tokens from this unit, gaining 1 strength for each removed.

acts.name: Holy Water
acts.text: 1 holy damage and (3+) create a hazard under target.

acts.name: Excoriate
acts.text: On hit: 1 damage, and Stance (Odd): splash (self) 1 holy damage, (Even): gain 1 vitality.

upgrades.name: Holy Blood
upgrades.text: Mea Culpa creates one or (4+) two hazards in free adjacent spaces.

upgrades.name: Eager
upgrades.text: May step 2 before using Mea Culpa.

traits.name: Miracle
traits.text: 5+ chance to return to life at 1 hp at the end of a turn it is slain.

acts.name: Gentleness
acts.text: Become unable to MOVE or step until start of next turn. Then adjacent allies gain 1 vitality.

acts.name: Delay Judgement
acts.text: An ally in range gains miracle. If it already had miracle, miracle triggers on 2+ until end of their next turn.

acts.name: Blessed Censer
acts.text: Splash (self): Stance (Even): allies gain 1 vitality, (Odd): foes take 1 holy damage.

upgrades.name: Cleansing Prayer
upgrades.text: Self and adjacent units are curseproof during Gentleness.

upgrades.name: Consecrate
upgrades.text: Blessed Censer may remove up to three corpses or hazards in range.

upgrades.name: Boiling Censer
upgrades.text: Stance (Round 4+): Blessed Censer's effects trigger twice.

traits.name: Miracle
traits.text: 5+ chance to return to life at 1 hp at the end of a turn it is slain.

traits.name: Zealotry
traits.text: When MOVEing for the second time or more in a turn, gain 1 vitality.

acts.name: Smite
acts.text: Stance: MOVE again. The next Whirling Chain deals +damage equal to half the round number, rounded up.

acts.name: Whirling Chain
acts.text: On hit: 2 damage. Stance (Odd): and MOVE again, (Even): and push unit 2.

upgrades.name: Suffuse
upgrades.text: Smite removes a negative token from this unit.

upgrades.name: Punisher
upgrades.text: Stance: Whirling Chain obliterates foes it slays at round 3+.

upgrades.name: Fiery Chain
upgrades.text: Whirling Chain creates one or (5+) two hazards adjacent to its target after it resolves.

traits.name: Miracle
traits.text: 5+ chance to return to life at 1 hp at the end of a turn it is slain.

acts.name: Winch
acts.text: Step 1. Next attack gains +1D and +2 max range. This effect stacks.

acts.name: Requiesce en Pace
acts.text: On hit: 2 damage. Stance (Round 3+): with piercing. (Round 5+): 4 damage with piercing.

upgrades.name: Focus
upgrades.text: If this unit does not move during its turn, it may remove a negative token from itself.

upgrades.name: Heart Destroyer
upgrades.text: Stance: Requiesce en Pace obliterates units it slays at round 3+.

upgrades.name: Explosive Bolts
upgrades.text: Stance: Requiesce en Pace pushes units one, (Round 3+) two, or (Round 5+) four spaces.

traits.name: Miraculous Flesh
traits.text: Lacks Miracle, but starts combat with 4 vitality tokens.

traits.name: Tyrant
traits.text: 2x2 unit. Large: ignores elevation, cannot take cover, affected by terrain once.

acts.name: Bolides
acts.text: Create one, (3+) two, (5+) or three hazards in range. May destroy a wall instead of creating a hazard.

acts.name: Indignation
acts.text: Remove one or two vitality on this unit, then deal 1 holy damage to that many units in range and push them 1.

acts.name: Ablutions
acts.text: Gain two vitality. Until start of next turn, adjacent allies may spend this unit's vitality as their own.

upgrades.name: Scathe
upgrades.text: When Bolides destroys a wall, it can deal 1 damage to an adjacent foe.

upgrades.name: Holy Font
upgrades.text: Ablutions gains stance (round 3+): gain 3 vitality instead, (round 5+): 4.

upgrades.name: Witness
upgrades.text: Indignation gains stance (round 4+): deal 2 holy damage instead.
